_comment: enabled:false = kill switch (compose, publish nothing). mode:draft = Buffer drafts for review / live = schedule for real. research_per_day = target AI-trend posts per day, EACH cross-posted to every channel in `channels` (raise this digit to scale up; the quality gate still applies). linkedin_format = the LinkedIn format policy (full rules in config/carousel.md). 'text-first' (CURRENT, 2026-06-16 pivot) = LinkedIn posts default to hook-driven TEXT; a carousel deck ships only on the rare day a topic clears the deck-worthy gate (a genuine framework / data breakdown / step-by-step on a hiring or AI-x-hiring topic) AND no carousel has already shipped this ISO week (~1x/week MAX, most days no deck). 'carousel' (LEGACY/DORMANT) = every LinkedIn post ships as a carousel PDF deck, one per research topic. 'auto' = the old conditional (carousel only for framework/breakdown posts, no weekly cap). X has no native carousel (single image only) and is suspended anyway. skip_days = weekday abbrevs (UTC) to NOT post on (mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun). posting_windows_local + posting_timezone are AUTHORITATIVE (2026-08-08 AU-timezone pivot): posting_windows_local is an ordered list of 'HH:MM-HH:MM' windows in the audience's LOCAL wall clock, posting_timezone names the IANA zone; current value posting_timezone='Australia/Sydney', posting_windows_local=['15:00-17:00','21:00-22:30'] (the AU afternoon and evening engagement peaks, per Buffer's July 2026 analysis). Run `python3 tools/posting_window.py` (Step 8) to convert these to UTC for today's date, DST-aware (AEST UTC+10 / AEDT UTC+11), before scheduling dueAt. posting_windows_utc is now only a STALE-CACHE fallback: it holds the correct UTC conversion as of whenever it was last hand-edited, but goes an hour stale at each Australian DST switch (start/end of AEDT) until someone re-runs the conversion, so treat it as a fallback for when the conversion script cannot run, never as the source of truth. With research_per_day=1 the day's single post lands in window 1. Edit posting_windows_local (and posting_timezone if the audience ever changes) to retime posts, no routine-prompt change needed. The Ployo diary routine separately posts 1 diary/day to these same channels. product_spotlight = a SECOND content stream (separate from research_per_day): a builder's-lens take on a notable NEW PRODUCT launch (Product Hunt / Show HN). enabled = on/off; run = which daily run produces it ('second' = the 12:30 UTC run only); linkedin_max_per_week = hard cap on product-spotlight LinkedIn carousels per ISO week (X is daily, uncapped). Full rules + the builder's-lens framing (never a thumbs-up/down verdict, never dunk on the makers) live in config/product-spotlight.md. takes = a THIRD stream (X-only, TEXT-only): one of Ahmed's pre-approved strongest opinions from state/opinion-bank.json, developed into a standalone long-form X post (no image/link/thread, never LinkedIn). enabled = on/off; per_day = max takes/UTC-day (start 1; bump to 2 AND set run:'any' to scale); run = which run fires it ('first' = 00:30 UTC run -> morning window, 'second' = 12:30, 'any' = both -- with per_day:1 'any' means the FIRST run of the day that hasn't hit the cap, i.e. normally the morning run, and the daily guard prevents doubles; 'any' also lets manual test runs produce one). Full rules in config/takes.md; the bank is hand-edited by Ahmed, the routine only updates last_used/times_used.
